subject: Re: FWL status: 6.1% long-doc perplexity gain, JAX gradient bug
body:
Team,

Integration decision, made with Bruno this morning: the TensorFlow implementation ships. It subclasses tf.keras.layers.Layer, drops cleanly into the assistant's serving stack, and it is the thoroughly tested path. Gustavo's JAX fix lands upstream as a contribution, but JAX productization waits for Q4.

The 6.1% long-doc perplexity gain at 8x less cost than dynamic evaluation is the number for the launch-planning review — Quentin, one-pager by Jul 10 please.

Scope cut: vocabulary-resizing experiments are out for Q3; we ship at the current vocab size.

Thanks all — clean milestone.

Priya
